name: a cost whose unit carries a soft hyphen
why: A soft hyphen draws nothing unless the line happens to break on it, so a required value can be made of them and show a reader nothing while passing for a value -- and in the middle of a word it splits what the page shows from what the snapshot says. Outside the characters a fact may carry (decided on #27, 28 Oct 2026).

rows.lead: Work undone as fast as it was done.
rows.claim: Thirty-two removal commits deleting what had just been written.
